newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's 52-week bills seen at 5.34 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's 52-week bills seen at 5.34 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $19.25 billion in 52-week bills on Thursday is expected to produce an average rate between 5.34 and 5.345 percent, traders said.
"We're expecting some demand for the notes ... There are some shorts to be covered and the securities are looking somewhat cheap," said a trader at a major foreign bank.

The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT. In when-issued trade at around 1230 EST/1730 GMT, three-month bill rates were quoted at 5.3375 percent.
